blocker.detail: tick-budget: Lead the group to the armored vehicle

ledger.text: Nadia: Stay on the path. They're nervous tonight — so are we.
…research campus past Hollow Creek reports a counter-agent… evacuation from the Hollow Creek bridge at dawn… all units…
Major Hale: You're the courier. Heard about you. Get some rest — you've earned one night.
Nadia: Sixteen years old. Grumpiest cat in the state.
Hale: Tunnels! Get the civilians to the plaza!
Nadia: Not him. Not the old one…

phases.label: sanctuary: Follow Nadia to the central plaza
escape: Lead the group to the armored vehicle
